segments.name: Casualty
products: contractor and site pollution liability coverage
segments.description: Provides tailored primary and excess casualty solutions, including general liability and environmental liability, for complex risks across many industries.
segments.evidence: Our Casualty division provides tailored solutions on a primary and excess basis and consists of a team of experienced underwriters with nationwide capabilities who excel at handling complex risks.

segments.name: Professional Liability
segments.description: Offers management and professional liability coverage on an admitted and E&S basis for financial institutions, not-for-profits and other entities.
segments.evidence: We offer management liability products, including directors and officers liability, errors and omissions liability, employment practices liability, fiduciary liability, fidelity liability and miscellaneous professional liability, crime insurance, and cyber liability.

segments.name: Healthcare Liability
segments.description: Provides tailored liability solutions solely for healthcare entities including hospitals, medical facilities, senior care providers and managed care organizations.
segments.evidence: Bowhead's Healthcare Liability division focuses solely on healthcare entities to provide tailored solutions.

segments.name: Baleen Specialty
segments.description: A technology-powered underwriting operation specializing in small to mid-sized non-admitted risks, distributed wholesale-only.
segments.evidence: Baleen Specialty is a technology-powered underwriting operation that specializes in small to mid-sized risks that are not eligible in the admitted market.
